title: Dalton Fury: Bin Laden in sights three times, strike denied

tellings.quote: he went on 60 Minutes in disguise to tell Scott Pell that he had Direct OverWatch on Bin Laden on three separate occasions

plain: In 2001, at Tora Bora in Afghanistan, a man known as Dalton Fury says he had the terrorist leader Osama bin Laden directly in view on three separate occasions, but the strike was not allowed. John Blitch, a former scientist at the Pentagon's advanced research agency, retells this from what Fury said in disguise to the reporter Scott Pelley on 60 Minutes, a US television news programme, and from the book Kill Bin Laden. If true, it would mean the chance to get bin Laden was turned down from above.
